entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return a pair of cycling shoes. Order number is 94-Alpha-335.

Certainly, I can look into that for you. Just pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the shoes here. To process this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't fit. They're causing horrible blisters, and I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times but can't get them right. I just need a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return them?
Yes, you can. I see they were delivered 29 days ago, which is well within our 90-day policy for a standard return. I've just approved it for you.

I'm sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid return label. Please pack the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any postal service location. Your full refund will be processed as soon as we receive them.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
